name: sportlers lodge Sölden
beschreibung: The Sportlers Lodge is centrally located in Sölden, just a few minutes' walk from the town center and the Giggijochbahn. The house offers a casual, sporty atmosphere with bright rooms and a small sauna. Guests can expect an uncomplicated ambience with a good breakfast and personal service – ideal for active holidaymakers who want to explore the Ötztaler Alpen.
